title: Where to find all ancient equipment in Final Fantasy Resonance

title: Fossil footprints span 12 Thai provinces with a 120-million-year-old trail in Udon Thani
description: Six dinosaur footprints in Udon Thani date back about 120 million years and offer fresh evidence of Thailand’s prehistoric wildlife.

title: New Fossil Confirms a Human Ancestor Appeared 200,000 Years Earlier Than Expected
description: The fossil record shows that our Homo erectus ancestors were the first hominins to show signs of adapting to life on the ground, with longer legs and shorter arms emerging (the name translates to 'upright human').

title: Kapisa: The Ancient Kingdom North of Kabul at the Gateway of the Hindu Kush
description: The fifth-century BCE grammarian Pāṇini referred to Kāpiśī, understood as the city of the Kapisa country. The Getty Research Institute's geographical database identifies Begram with ancient Kapisa and records Pāṇini among the earliest sources referring to the city. title: Sanskrit was spoken on Silk Roads — 1,000-yr-old fragments reveal lives of ancient Indians
description: A 1,000-year-old Sanskrit-Khotanese phrasebook offers a remarkable insight into the lives of Indian monks and pilgrims along the Silk Roads — the questions they were asked and the answers they gave.
